## ZGTA V — AppSync installer

**2.0 beta · by zema · experimental**

For compatible **ARM64 rootful jailbreaks on iOS 15.0–18.2**. Not for RootHide or rootless. Own prepared game files required.

Add `https://cydia.akemi.ai/` in Sileo for **AppSync Unified 116.0+** and **appinst 2.1.1+**. Install with a compatible jailbreak active. Dependency availability and ZGTA V installation/gameplay through AppSync remain unverified.

Use the separate TrollStore installer if you already use compatible TrollStore. Removing this installer leaves the app/data installed.

[Installation and compatibility](https://github.com/zemabinks/repo/blob/main/docs/zgta-v-installation.md) · [Other sideloaders](https://github.com/zemabinks/ZGTA-V/blob/main/docs/IOS-SIDELOADING.md)
[Remote play with Tailscale](https://github.com/zemabinks/ZGTA-V/blob/main/docs/REMOTE-PLAY.md) — downloads, setup, host and join steps.
